name: blussh
author: Pablo Pusiol
description: Host connectivity monitor: discovers hosts from ssh config, Tailscale and ZeroTier, shows live status and notifies when they go down or come back up.

barWidget.description: Live status of your ssh config, Tailscale and ZeroTier hosts, with one-key ssh copy and connect.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: A state change must repeat on two consecutive checks before it notifies.

schema.label: Host sources
schema.description: Where hosts are discovered from. Leave empty to use all of them.

options.label: SSH config
options.description: Host entries from your ssh config files

options.label: ZeroTier
options.description: Members of joined networks via ZeroTier Central

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Notify when a host goes down or comes back up.

schema.label: Hide hidden hosts
schema.description: Leave hosts you hid (which also stops monitoring them) out of the panel.
